name: Financial Regulation Domain (stub)
disclaimer: The Financial Regulation domain is a design-phase stub. It does not provide financial, investment, tax, or securities advice and does not create an advisor-client relationship. Every answer must recommend consultation with a licensed adviser and the relevant regulator (BoG, SEC-Ghana, GRA) before any transaction.
implementation_notes: Stub only. To become real: (1) acquire regulatory corpus (Bank of Ghana, Securities and Exchange Commission, Ghana Revenue Authority, Companies Act 2019 sections on financial services), (2) build isolated storage under core/finance_brain/, (3) implement a DomainPlugin subclass with a mandatory 'not investment advice' preface, (4) trust-score weighting favoring primary regulator sources, (5) operator activation via POST /api/legal/domains/finance/activate.
